claim_scope: External-provider derivative, convergence, and local timing audit only. It does not promote a MAPLE runtime provider.

decision.reason: Derivative validity is necessary but not sufficient; accuracy and product-appropriate performance are scored separately before any provider admission.

numerical_convergence_gate.selection_policy: union of ten largest maximum Cartesian spans and ten smallest SHA-256 compound-ID digests, excluding duplicates; no target property used

performance_comparison.claim_scope: Same local 23-atom molecule; ddPCM is one audit call while OpenMM and MACE values are warm medians from frozen traces. Ratios are diagnostic, not universal throughput claims.

physical_model.native_force_api_semantics: State.solvation_force_terms plus State.multipole_force_terms numerically equals positive dE/dR in native Hartree/Bohr units despite the force_terms name.
